description:
As a member of our affilaite program: The Vibe Tribe, you'll be marketing a line of fun, comfortable, high-quality and stylish travel leisure. From super comfortable hoodies and sweatshirts, to stylish hats and practical accessories, people can feel their best not only on their flights to their next destination, but also around town as day-to-day wear.

As a member of The Vibe Tribe you'll receive a 10% commision off of purchases made via your unique link, and be paid out via PayPal on a monthly basis. In addition, you'll also receive an exclusive, one-time, discount code for you to personally use to buy products from our store.

We're looking forward to working with you!
